name: Raytrax
tagline: Electron Cyclotron Resonance Heating for Fusion Plasmas in JAX
description: Raytrax simulates Electron Cyclotron Resonance Heating (ECRH) of magnetic confinement fusion plasmas. Powered by [JAX](https://docs.jax.dev/), it features JIT-compiled ray tracing and automatic differentiation – making it well-suited for gradient-based beam optimization in fusion plant design.
